answer: Locks are recorded in whisper, expire in meadow, and walnut lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 153 aliases as a result needs 43 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3451 identities would post 2249 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
